label_definition: absolute zero: (Y mm, T deg) relative to the pose whose image equals center.bmp (rig_1st/center.bmp); labels are stage commands corrected by vision pose (L2, label_correction.py). Sign follows the rig stage command (opposite to SEMES).
training_recipe: shared normalized Huber IRLS6, ridge1e-7, no augmentation. 5 values: QR NCC (Gaussian sigma 2 blur before NCC, 3-point parabola) mean dx + 4 screw gradient dx; bar tilts unused. 2026-11-13. Previous model final00_huber7_qrncc5_rig20261112_1959_irls6_r1e-7
scope: All 1959 measured rig photos (rig_1st 280, rig_grid 1679) fitted. Experiment asset, not a delivery model.
input_contract: single 3840x2160 uint8 image; no labels, date or filename in inference
known_limits: corrected labels come from the same image values, so scores are not against an independent truth; one set of two captures on one day; closed-loop return not validated

track536.note: same photos, labels and splits as the default model; QR value measured with track536

health_note: value-consistency check (experiment 20261113_2230): per used value, quadratic in model output (Y, T); scale = 1.4826 MAD; threshold = 1.5 x 99.9 percentile of training H. Fitted on the same photos as the model with final00_tool health (C++).
